elements.description:
Where an output came from: run, turns, queries and tools, source chunks, claims and artifacts in columns, every
node's record a click away.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading in the bar, and the graph's name

properties.name: columns
properties.default: [ { id: "run", label: "Run", tone: "neutral" }, { id: "turn", label: "Turns", tone: "blue" }, { id: "query", label: "Queries & tools", tone: "amber" }, { id: "chunk", label: "Source chunks", tone: "teal" }, { id: "claim", label: "Claims", tone: "violet" }, { id: "artifact", label: "Artifacts", tone: "rose" }, ]
properties.description: The columns, cause to effect – a node sits in the column its `column` names; columns without nodes don't show

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: Everything in the lineage: the run, turns, queries and tools, source chunks, claims, artifacts

properties.name: edges
properties.description: The links, from what came first to what it fed

properties.name: selected
properties.description:
The node whose record is open (null = none). Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls
preventDefault()

properties.name: view
properties.description:
"graph" or "chain" (the event chain). Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls
preventDefault()

properties.name: weakLabel
properties.description: What a weak link means – in the legend, and in a node's links when the link has no note of its own

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: Shown when there are no nodes

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A node's record was opened or closed ({ selected, node }: LineageSelectedChange; selected is null when closed); cancelable

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: The Graph or Event chain tab was picked ({ view }: LineageViewChange); cancelable

functions.name: LINEAGE_COLUMNS
functions.description: The columns of an AI output's lineage, cause to effect

props.name: title
props.description: The heading in the bar, and the graph's name

props.name: selected
props.description:
The id of the node whose record is open. Controlled when defined (null = none); otherwise the component keeps
it, starting at `defaultSelected`

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the node whose record opened, or null when it closed

props.name: view
props.description: "graph" or "chain" (the event chain). Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps it

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when the Graph or Event chain tab is picked
